problem: The ScientificObject Viewer registry advertised analysis.rdf and reciprocal.brillouin_zone as object types although the authoritative ScientificObject registry does not register either type.
root_cause: Result/Artifact renderer contracts were mixed into an object-version Viewer registry.
decision: Explicitly classify both as result-only viewer contracts. Do not create ScientificObject identity, version, archive or restore semantics for them.

change.object_route_behavior: unregistered object types remain rejected by ScientificObject authority
